quests.title: The Lost Key
quests.desc: Find the hermit's lost key inside his house.
quests.dialog_offer: The hermit in the house lost his key. Could you find it for him, {PLAYER}?
quests.dialog_active: Have you found the key yet? Check inside the house.
quests.dialog_complete: You found the key! Here is 25 gold as thanks, {PLAYER}.

quests.title: Coin Collector
quests.desc: Collect 5 gold coins scattered across the overworld.
quests.dialog_offer: I have another task. Collect 5 gold coins from the field. Interested, {PLAYER}?
quests.dialog_active: Keep collecting those coins! You're doing great.
quests.dialog_complete: All coins collected! Here, take this Lucky Charm.

quests.title: Guard's Report
quests.desc: Speak with the guard and report back.
quests.dialog_offer: Report to the Old Man that you spoke to me. He'll reward you!
quests.dialog_active: Go see the Old Man for your reward.
quests.dialog_complete: Good work reporting to the guard! Here is your reward.

quests.title: Shopping Spree
quests.desc: Buy 3 items from the merchant's shop.
quests.dialog_offer: Buy 3 items and I'll give you a loyal customer discount — 30 gold back!
quests.dialog_complete: A loyal customer! Here's 30 gold back as promised!

quests.title: Hermit's Gratitude
quests.desc: Return the key to the hermit.
quests.dialog_offer: You have my key! Please, give it back to me.
quests.dialog_active: Do you still have my key?
quests.dialog_complete: Thank you so much, {PLAYER}! Take this old map I found.
